svg.title: Releases: versions a team ships, with “fixed in” on tickets and release notes — SoftTrack web design mockup (#272)
svg.desc: A sprint says when work was done and an epic what it was part of, and neither says which version it shipped in. A release belongs to a team, tickets carry a fix version, a release’s page lists what is and is not done, releasing asks what to do with the rest, and release notes are drafted from the done tickets.
